def check_monthnumber_number(month):
    """
    Checks whether the given month number contains exactly 30 days.
    
    Args:
        month (int): Month number from 1 to 12.
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if the month has 30 days, False otherwise.
    """
    # List of months that have exactly 30 days
    thirty_day_months = {4, 6, 9, 11}
    
    return month in thirty_day_months

# Test cases based on your requirement and additional edge cases
assert check_monthnumber_number(6) == True   # June has 30 days -> Passes
assert check_monthnumber_number(2) == False  # February does not have exactly 30 days
assert check_monthnumber_number(1) == False  # January has 31 days
assert check_monthnumber_number(4) == True   # April has 30 days

print("All assertions passed!")

def check_monthnumber_number(month):

    Args:
        month (int): Month number from 1 to 12.
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if the month has 30 days, False otherwise.
    """
    # List of months that have exactly 30 days
    thirty_day_months = {4, 6, 9, 11}
    
    return month in thirty_day_months

# Test cases based on your requirement and additional edge cases
